verification.test_guarantee_scope: The unit test covers the shared predicate palette_dispatch_allowed(open, marked) only. It does not execute palette_activate or palette_invoke_slot, because both need a GPUI Window and Context that the crate's test harness does not provide; a source-text assertion that the two functions call the predicate would be the forbidden kind of test, so none was added. What guarantees the call sites is the single-boundary structure plus code review, not a test.
